summary: One and One Green Technologies, Inc., a Philippines-based recycler, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 2, 2026, announcing procurement of over 2,000 tons of raw materials for a new electronic, copper, and nickel sludge recovery line. The filing describes ongoing equipment installation and expects production to begin before year-end 2026. This is a routine operational update on business expansion, not a special situation. No financial terms, board actions, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. It does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other category. The event is an ordinary operational milestone.
